findings.finding: Open questions for ui/public/LLMs.txt and direct static legal page access were implementation-shaping and blocked approval.
Governance state was inconsistent because the RFC status was Accepted while challenge resolution was pending and the plan was marked accepted-candidate.
The CONFIG.theme source-of-truth acceptance criterion was too broad to verify without a concrete scan boundary and allowlist policy.
The shared logo component was optional even though several surfaces require the same fallback contract.

resolution: Chose neutral ui/public/LLMs.txt for the first implementation.
Chose to keep direct static legal routes accessible while tenant-visible navigation uses configured legal links.
Added a bounded brand scan contract and explicit allowlist policy.
Made BrandedLogo required for tenant-visible brand rendering in shell, onboarding, and preview surfaces.
Updated Challenge Resolution to record the round 1 outcome and resolutions.
next_step: Rerun independent challenge on revised RFC bytes.
